payload.claim: The Problem section instructs adding the new retired_first check to `test_no_real_spec_is_refused_on_its_own_acceptance_criteria` as a third named shape, beside `disclosed` and `claude_touching`, implying the test currently excludes only those two names from its final `depends_on` assert. At this base snapshot the test already has a third exclusion, `inline_mutant` (added by `SA-0338`, confirmed absent at `747cdc8f` where the spec's citations were read), which the final assert already subtracts. A cell that follows the instruction literally and treats the exclusion set as having only two prior members risks reconstructing the final `all(...)` check with just `disclosed`, `claude_touching`, and the new `retired_first` filter, dropping the already-necessary `inline_mutant` exclusion and breaking this test (over 30 refusal rows depend on that exclusion).
